## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Mixed internals — pockets of strength in semis, utilities and banks offset by weakness in energy and large-cap software; major divergence among mega-caps limits conviction.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +11.87% | 1M: +21.56%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +11.09% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND. Financials strong: COF (1W: +10.71% | 1M: +10.71%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials: CAT (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +14.61%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +0.49% | 1M: +3.59%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -15.22%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -6.56% | 1M: -11.97%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare soft: JNJ (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -0.13%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -5.37% | 1M: +7.55%) CORRECTION. Communication mixed with weakness: CHTR (1W: -9.28% | 1M: -11.42%) BELOW TREND while TTWO is an outlier.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, TTWO (1W: +12.83% | 1M: +0.48%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +11.87% | 1M: +21.56%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +51.85%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +11.41% | 1M: +16.02%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology) — growth skew but concentration risk.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: LMT (1W: -6.88% | 1M: -2.34%) BELOW TREND, VLO (1W: -7.55% | 1M: -9.59%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -7.80% | 1M: -6.67%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -15.19%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -9.28% | 1M: -11.42%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in specific industrials, energy and select software names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +14.56%), TTWO (1W: +12.83%), AMAT (1W: +11.67%), QCOM (1W: +11.41%), VST (1W: +11.87%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence: several mega-caps (AAPL, NVDA, GOOGL, META) show 1W up vs 1M down (RECOVERY) while MSFT, ADBE, ACN are BELOW TREND — tactical volatility, not a confirmed regime shift.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but active: AMAT (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +51.85%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +10.02% | 1M: +29.78%) ABOVE TREND versus MSFT (1W: -2.80% | 1M: -8.91%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -23.46%) BELOW TREND and CRM (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -15.19%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth positive but leadership concentrated; watch for rotation within tech.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive: JPM (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +10.71% | 1M: +10.71%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.57% | 1M: -0.81%) RECOVERY — sector acting as a stabilizer and offering cyclical exposure amid mixed tech.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Soft overall: JNJ (1W: -4.17% | 1M: -0.13%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -0.57% | 1M: +3.60%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -5.37% | 1M: +7.55%) CORRECTION — earnings and micro headlines driving idiosyncratic moves; sector breadth weak.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and Industrials exposure (JPM, CAT, COF) to capture current rotation into cyclicals; reduce exposure to large-cap software names showing clear BELOW TREND (ACN, ADBE, CRM). Style: mixed — tactical tilt toward value/cyclicals within a NEUTRAL market given leadership concentration and macro uncertainty.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +11.67% | 1M: +51.85%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +14.61%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ACN (1W: -23.60% | 1M: -27.61%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -10.80% | 1M: -23.46%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -15.22%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities, Financials, Industrials (Breadth supportive). BEARISH: Energy, Healthcare, Communication (watch sentiment and earnings headlines).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch tech leadership confirmation via sustained weekly closes above recent 1W highs for INTC/AMAT; monitor JPM and CAT weekly follow-through to confirm cyclical rotation; flag ACN/ADBE for further downside if they close below this week’s lows — sentiment-driven moves likely to accelerate.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
INTC (+50): Apple partnership headline; INTC (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by large 1W move. TTWO (+60): GTA VI preorder push; TTWO (1W: +12.83% | 1M: +0.48%) ABOVE TREND — catalyst-driven breakout. CEG (+55): Three Mile Island restart news; CEG (1W: +11.09% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price aligned.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ACN (-50): cautious outlook headlines; ACN (1W: -23.60% | 1M: -27.61%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and severe. TSLA (-50): Jefferies downside warning; TSLA (1W: +0.34% | 1M: -0.90%) RECOVERY — headline divergence vs short-term price bounce, monitor. WMT (-45): China food safety headline; WMT (1W: -2.76% | 1M: -12.68%) BELOW TREND — sentiment consistent with weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. INTC ABOVE TREND, AMAT ABOVE TREND and CAT ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among mega-caps (MSFT/ADBE/ACN BELOW TREND vs semis and selected cyclicals ABOVE TREND) and headline-driven downside in ACN/TSLA — monitor sentiment vs price for confirmation.
